@graph.name: Houston Sunset Skyline Kayak Tour
@graph.description: Join us for a cool evening out on the water to watch the sun say goodnight to the Houston skyline. An easy two-hour guided kayak tour departing at 4 p.m. from 1019 Commerce Street in downtown Houston. All skill levels welcome.

mainEntity.name: What time does the Sunset Skyline Kayak Tour depart?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Sunset Skyline Tour departs at 4 p.m. and runs until approximately 6 p.m. Please arrive at least 15 minutes early for check-in and a safety briefing.

mainEntity.name: How much does the Sunset Skyline Kayak Tour cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Sunset Skyline Kayak Tour is $55 per person. Book online to reserve your spot.

mainEntity.name: How long is the Sunset Skyline Tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: The tour lasts approximately 2 hours on the water, departing at 4 p.m. from 1019 Commerce Street in downtown Houston.

mainEntity.name: Do I need kayaking experience to join the Sunset Skyline Tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: No experience is needed. The Sunset Skyline Tour is designed for all skill levels, including first-timers. Guides provide a safety briefing and paddle instruction before you launch.
